name: Akhellis
source:
Akhellis – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Akhellis is nearly fully bronze nearly-elderly blue-eyed om'verai, with 3 cheek whiskers. Akhellis' chest is covered by an amber jewellery with teeth-like sides. The only non-bronze body area are white horns with gold bracelets, and upper part of a neck. Bears a rod with a gem on its edge, alongside with spheres.
Akhellis is a mysterious, yet, wise, polite and caring om'verai. Akhellis is good in spying without even being noticed before revealing herself. Despite of her traits, Akhellis has a pretty bad reputation in eyes of some characters.
